Model meaning: fraction of charged power deposited in the blanket circuits, remainder to the divertor. Inherited 0.25 is assumption A1. Lyon Table IV prints 98.1 MW to the divertor of 487 MW charged power; Raffray Table V implies 66.8 MW of nuclear heating in the divertor at 2365 MW (186 minus 24 friction, 23.6 conducted, 23.6 alpha loss, 48 radiated), 68.8 MW scaled to 2436 MW. Divertor deposition 167 MW gives 1 minus 167/487.2 = 0.657; the nuclear share is carried as charged power because the model has no divertor nuclear-heating term.
Raffray Table II: 111 MW conducted from PbLi to He at 2365 MW fusion, 0.0469 of fusion power; inherited 0.04 is assumption A1.

Mode 0 is the inherited series arrangement (helium, then divertor, then PbLi in one cycle stream; WI-089). Mode 1 represents Raffray Fig. 12 (p. 741): the blanket-helium exchanger first, then the PbLi and divertor-helium exchangers in parallel on split cycle flow, rejoining before the turbine (WI-092 design, reviewed).

Fraction of cycle flow through the PbLi stage in mode 1; no source states it. Raffray duty shares (1444 MW PbLi, 186 MW divertor; Tables II and V) imply about 0.89 for equal branch temperature rises; the design default is 0.85; 0.50 to 0.98 brackets the response. Ignored in mode 0.

Inherited 1600 MW offered compressor capacity is assumption A6 (WI-089). The separately named resized-compressor alternative sets the rating to 1700 or 1800 MW alongside the same cycle flow; it is a declared hardware change studied for its purpose and never a reference reproduction.

Raffray Table II prints 3261 kg/s for the 2365 MW case; the reference-case contract § 8 scales duties to 2436 MW by 1.030 while the flow was held at 3261; 3359 kg/s is that flow scaled with the duty (contract § 6a, Q1 review finding 2). A supplied operating flow, never derived from demand.
Raffray Table II prints 26,860 kg/s; 27,666 kg/s is that flow scaled by 1.030 with the duty (contract § 6a). A supplied operating flow, never derived from demand.
